title: Local values name expressions
summary: locals name calculated values used inside a configuration. They are not inputs supplied from outside like variables.
introduction: locals name calculated values used inside a configuration. They are not inputs supplied from outside like variables. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: Use local.greeting for a local value and var.club_name for a variable.
